workOrders.title: The commercial kit: @rottay/design-system/commercial

progressLog.note: Foundation built (Opus): commercial ramp tokens (11-step perceptually-even L* grayscale + ink/paper/hairline/texture/motion in commercial-ramp.css + TS mirror tokens/index.ts); shared _internal/motion (useReducedMotion + useReveal, one-shot + reduced-motion-collapse); reference components AsciiFrame + SectionFrame (folder/index.tsx + .types.ts + .css pattern, rt-* classes, aria-hidden decorative ASCII, tokens-not-literals). NEXT: delegate the 9 remaining components to Sonnet against this pattern, then wire subpath export (commercial.ts + vite lib.entry + package.json exports/build:commercial-css) + gates + sighted capture.

Export wiring done (Opus, surgical — owner package.json WIP untouched): vite.config.ts lib.entry += commercial; package.json exports += ./commercial (js) + ./commercial.css (style) + files entry + build:commercial-css postcss step chained into build. 6 Sonnet agents building the 9 remaining components in parallel (Typewriter+TerminalBlock / TreeView+CropMarks / InvertSection+TextureBackdrop / MonoStat / AsciiDiagram / ProductWindow), each to its own folder against the AsciiFrame/SectionFrame reference pattern. NEXT (blocked on their return): audit each vs monochrome+a11y+motion fences, write src/commercial.ts barrel, unit tests (render + aria-hidden + reduced-motion), build gate, docs update, sighted capture.

Docs catalog page drafted (Opus): docs-engineering/engineering/design-system/commercial/README.md (kit purpose, two laws, ramp tokens, component table, consuming). Step 5 of the WO done. STILL WAITING on the 6 Sonnet agents (9 component folders still empty at this poll — not interfering). Remaining after they land: audit each vs fences, src/commercial.ts barrel, unit tests, pnpm build gate, sighted capture under both tenant palettes.

10/11 components landed + audited CLEAN (Opus audit): grep proves ZERO non-grayscale color literals across all component files; export names all convention-correct; domain-noun sweep clean after fixing ProductWindow comments (tenant->brand, 3 files). Barrel src/commercial.ts written (all 11 components + TS tokens). MonoStat/Typewriter/TerminalBlock verified reduced-motion-safe (start-at-final-value, aria-hidden animated, visually-hidden full text). ONLY AsciiDiagram folder still empty (its Sonnet agent, the hardest component, still running — not interfering). REMAINING when it lands: reconcile barrel AsciiDiagram exports, write unit test (render + aria-hidden + reduced-motion collapse), pnpm build gate (tsc+vite emits dist/commercial.{js,cjs,d.ts}+css), pnpm test, sighted kit-inventory capture under both tenant palettes -> done.

SIGHTED CHECK caught 2 real bugs the unit tests missed (this is why sighted is mandatory): (1) per-component CSS was NOT shipping in the vite dist (only ramp tokens in commercial.css) -> visually-hidden spans rendered VISIBLE causing 601601 text doubling; (2) InvertSection paper surface never painted white. ROOT CAUSE: vite library build strips per-component 'import ./X.css' side-effects. FIX: new scripts/build-commercial-css.mjs concatenates ramp tokens + all 11 component stylesheets into the single dist/commercial.css (the sanctioned ./commercial.css export); package.json build:commercial-css repointed to it. Re-captured + re-reviewed: both bugs gone, kit renders premium monochrome under BOTH surfaces (ink dark + paper light), AsciiDiagram signature clean, ProductWindow color pass-through works. Full pnpm build re-run exit 0.
